resultset.statement: -- Buffering window function (RANGE frame, not the ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING..CURRENT ROW -- default) whose argument tree contains an IN-subquery. This forces -- Item_in_optimizer / Item_in_subselect / Item_ref accumulation inside a -- window function argument, and forces window output materialization through -- CreateFramebufferTable. SELECT s.k, s.v, SUM(CASE WHEN s.k IN (SELECT k FROM wf_prop_sub) THEN s.v ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY s.k ORDER BY s.v RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS win_sum FROM wf_prop_src AS s ORDER BY s.k, s.v
SELECT s.k, s.v, SUM(wf_prop_fn(s.v)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.k ORDER BY s.v RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS win_fn_sum FROM wf_prop_src AS s ORDER BY s.k, s.v
